records.narrative: Remy has tried ordinary school tasks but cannot yet picture most work activities and uses Unsure honestly. review.reason: Uniform unsure responses yield no precise profession, preparation, or financial projection. The student can investigate settings without uncertainty being scored as inability. This is successful restraint, not a failed prediction.

records.name: Charlie: many interests still open
records.narrative: Charlie likes trying almost anything, from school projects to helping people and making things. None stands out reliably yet. In the creative branch Charlie selects every offered option because all sound interesting, not because each profession has distinct evidence. College, practical training and several working settings remain open; lifestyle preferences are similarly exploratory.

review.reason: An undifferentiated positive profile and selection of every option do not produce an artificial winning career or financial promise. More exposure and selective reflection are justified; manufacturing differentiation is not.
